The one frozen command, python -m pytest --pyargs joblib, exited 1 before collection because the immutable runtime had no pytest module. This is missing runner evidence, not a semantic joblib test failure.

Because collection never started and zero task outcomes were observed, the saved NOT_EVALUABLE status is required. O's own CI success is publication evidence only and is not substituted for the missing baseline outcome.

The smallest prospective repair is a distinct, preregistered Root unit using an immutable environment that already contains the selected distribution and its declared runner. It must repeat only the entry gate before any behavioral cases. Nothing is installed or patched and this closed gate is not replayed here.
